Who the PAWty Helps

Every Wagging Tail Supports Two Missions

Eye Spy Foundation

Eye Spy Foundation helps the blind and low vision community discover resources, build connections, and grow confidence through technology, education, and support. We're creating a more connected future while welcoming everyone with a hug, a handshake, and a sense of belonging.

Meet Eye Spy Foundation

Leader Dogs for the Blind

A portion of every purchase helps support a future Leader Dog puppy on its journey to becoming a guide dog. Through expert training and care, these remarkable dogs help people travel with greater confidence, independence, and freedom.

Learn about Leader Dogs for the Blind

Good to Know

Frequently Asked Questions

What is The Fashion PAWty?

The Fashion PAWty is a community dog fashion show hosted by Eye Spy Foundation where local pups walk the orange carpet to help raise support for Eye Spy Foundation and Leader Dogs for the Blind.

When and where is the event?

Saturday, September 26 from 4 – 7 PM at Happy Brew Coffee Shop, 3200 Hendricks Ave, Jacksonville, FL 32207. View the Venue Page .

How much are tickets?

PAWty Passes are $30 and include admission, food, mocktails, music, family fun, and the fashion show. Join the PAWty

Are kids allowed?

Absolutely. Children under 12 attend free when accompanied by an adult. Guests 12 and older should purchase a PAWty Pass.

Will there be food?

Yes. Your PAWty Pass includes food from Ole Mexican Restaurant . Vegetarian and gluten-free options will also be available.

Can I bring my dog?

To ensure a safe and enjoyable event for everyone, only dogs participating in the fashion show may attend. We love all pups, but space and safety considerations require us to limit attendance to registered runway participants.

Can my dog be in the show?

Maybe! We're looking for 10–15 amazing dogs to walk the runway. Participants should represent a local cause or business, be comfortable around crowds, be current on vaccinations, and be ready to show off their style. Use our contact form to inquire about participating.

Can I volunteer?

Yes. We're always looking for friendly volunteers to help with setup, check-in, activities, and event support. View our Contact page to get involved.

Who benefits from the event?

The Fashion PAWty supports Eye Spy Foundation and Leader Dogs for the Blind. Funds raised help support community resources, accessibility initiatives, and guide dog programs. View our Beneficiaries page to learn more.

Do I need to dress up?

Not at all. Come as you are, or have fun dressing in your best orange-carpet style. But if you're feeling the vibe, costumes are more than welcome.

More questions? Visit the full FAQ page or email team@eyespy.org.
